[LRST.4.1] Capture facts per [LCCO.5.2] are tied to a `call`'s
correlation. When `call ... as Y` is re-fired with the same
correlation, the new call's capture fact supersedes the prior
one via the same per-fact supersedure mechanism that
supersedes the response fact or `CallError` ([LCRS.6.2.1]). That mechanism is
keyed by correlation, not by identity: a response schema has no identity key
([LCRS.4.3.2]).
